Command palette Ctrl+K lists wired commands recents-first with category and chord, arrows navigate, Enter runs, Escape closes; capture mode consumes the key event so it never fires a command. Settings window (top bar) hosts Appearance + Hotkeys with per-row Clear/Reset, duplicate and save errors shown inline.
